code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_walls = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    col_walls = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + row_walls + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_walls + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = {}
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            marker = next((v for v in vals if v in (2, 3)), 0)
            cells[(ri, ci)] = (r0, r1, c0, c1, marker)
    # A 3 marks its entire compartment row; 2-marked compartments retain their identity.
    marked_rows = {ri for (ri, ci), cell in cells.items() if cell[4] == 3}
    for (ri, ci), (r0, r1, c0, c1, marker) in cells.items():
        color = 2 if marker == 2 else (3 if ri in marked_rows else 0)
        if marker == 2 and ri in marked_rows:
            color = 6
        if color:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
